subject: Operations
title: The SCOR Model
description: A quick win: understand The SCOR Model.

hook.text: How do you benchmark a supply chain? You need a common language. The SCOR model gives you one.

buildup.text: SCOR stands for Supply Chain Operations Reference. It defines five processes: Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return.

discovery.text: Each process has metrics, best practices, and standard definitions so companies can compare performance.

twist.text: SCOR doesn't tell you what to do—it tells you what to measure. Strategy still requires human judgment.

climax.text: Companies using SCOR benchmarks identify gaps faster and prioritize improvements that matter most.

punchline.text: Five processes. One framework. Universal language.
